title: XXXII. Of the Marriage of Prieſts.

segments.text: BIſhops, Prieſts, and Deacons, are not commanded by God's Law, either to vow the ſtate of ſingle Life, or to abſtain from Marriage: Therefore it is Lawful for them, as for all other Chriſtian men, to marry at their own Diſcretion, as they ſhall judge the ſame to ſerve better to Godlineſs.
